marine.title: Forecast for Tonight and Monday.
marine.text:
Wind west 15 knots increasing to west 25 after midnight then
diminishing to west 15 Monday afternoon. Periods of snow. Visibility 1 mile or less in
snow. Temperatures near minus 2. <br/>

marine.title: Waves for Tonight and Monday.
marine.text:
Over open water seas 1 metre or less building to 2 early Monday
morning then subsiding to 1 or less early Monday evening.<br/>
